title: One Time portal shell and preview boundaries

reasons: The source explicitly requests normalized One Time portal information architecture and a shared portal shell.
The current audit captured Family, Student, Classroom, Library, parent setup/reset, and review states across required viewports.
The work is app-visible and requires screenshots, action registry coverage, TEST-only preview proof, and no-write guardrails.
likely_external_provider_blockers: No external send, access grant, payment, Zoom, Drive, provider-account, DNS, WAPI, or deployment work is allowed in this packet.
recommended_packet_sequence: add shared portal shell CSS and JS
wire Family, Library, Classroom, parent setup/reset, parent review, and Student review routes to the shell
replace pseudo-element hamburger affordances with a real menu button
prove TEST preview boundaries and local screenshots
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Implement REQ-20260712-108 only; do not modify landing WhatsApp, bundle delivery, deploy, external sends, payment/access, or provider setup.

operator_intent_summary: Normalize One Time portal labels and shared shell behavior so families, students, classroom/library users, and preview reviewers see the same One Time brand frame, a real accessible mobile menu, clear account setup/reset copy, and explicit TEST preview/no-write boundaries.
raw_quotes: Normalize portal information architecture: /rabbi-member user-facing Family Portal, /student Student Portal, /one-time-classroom shared Classroom, /member-library Library, and /one-time-parent account setup/reset, with clear preview action labels.

Create a shared One Time portal shell across Family, Student, Classroom, Library, parent setup/reset, and preview modes with same logo, tokens, fonts, header, navigation, buttons, focus styles, footer, and role-appropriate links.

Replace the CSS pseudo-element hamburger with one real focusable/clickable accessible button supporting aria-controls, aria-expanded, Escape/backdrop close, focus trap, focus return, and responsive behavior.

Preview mode must show TEST PREVIEW / SAMPLE DATA / NO WRITES, preserve review mode across Family/Student/Classroom/Library, provide Exit Preview, enforce support boundaries, and use safe TEST synthetic student fixtures that never enter production CRM, reminders, sends, or metrics.

decisions_captured.decision: Original source screenshots are unavailable locally, so regenerated current-state audit and smoke screenshots are the implementation baseline.

out_of_scope: No public landing WhatsApp launcher work.
No live email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Zoom, Drive, Vimeo, payment, access grant, DNS, provider-account, production-data, GHL, LeadConnector, or external CRM writes.
No change to class access policy, real parent/student data, production reminders, live sends, or metrics ingestion.
No production Done claim before REQ-20260712-112 release/live-smoke proof.

inspected: Current-state audit exists under ops/ui-audits/2026-07-12-onetime-crm-portal-production-correction/ with desktop/tablet/mobile portal and review evidence.
public/rabbi-member.html and public/member-library.html use CSS pseudo-element hamburger drawings in mobile navigation.
public/one-time-classroom.html uses a top-actions pseudo-element hamburger in review/mobile state.
public/one-time-parent.html is already a password setup/reset route but needs stronger account setup/reset labeling.
public/student.html already has a real portal menu toggle for the student sidebar and One Time review mode, but the shared shell can add consistent preview banner/link preservation.
src/platform/instances/one-time-shared-review-data.js already uses TEST ids and @example.test emails for shared review fixtures.
known_gaps: /rabbi-member still reads as Member area instead of Family Portal in user-facing labels.
The One Time mobile menu affordance is sometimes a CSS pseudo-element rather than a focusable button.
Review mode is not consistently bannered as TEST PREVIEW / SAMPLE DATA / NO WRITES across portal routes.
Member Library does not yet have a simple review-mode bridge to the existing TEST member fixture.
Preview navigation can lose review mode when moving between Family, Student, Classroom, and Library.

expanded_phrases.professional: For this packet, professional means restrained portal UI consistency: same One Time logo, black/yellow token alignment, readable labels, keyboard focus, bounded actions, and no marketing-style rebuild.
expanded_phrases.working: For this packet, working means local navigation/menu/preview assertions pass without external writes or production data mutation.
expanded_phrases.shared One Time portal shell: A shared CSS/JS layer that normalizes labels, menu behavior, focus styles, preview banners, and review-link preservation while leaving page-specific content intact.
expanded_phrases.Family Portal: The user-facing name for /rabbi-member and its review entry; it includes library, live class, private questions, and support without calling the family-facing route a generic member page.
expanded_phrases.real accessible menu: A focusable button with aria-controls, aria-expanded, Escape close, outside/backdrop close, focus return, and keyboard containment while open.
expanded_phrases.TEST preview: Review mode must visibly declare TEST PREVIEW, SAMPLE DATA, and NO WRITES, and all fixture identities must remain TEST or @example.test.
expanded_phrases.support boundaries: Support UI can collect or simulate scoped member/parent/student support only; it must not expose admin diagnostics, raw private data, payment/access mutation, or external sends.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use the existing first-party One Time portal pages and review fixture API. Do not add GHL, LeadConnector, external CRM, or external provider runtimes.

findings.user_impact: Mobile users see a drawn hamburger that cannot receive focus, announce state, close with Escape, or return focus.
findings.expected_fix: Replace pseudo hamburger affordance with a real shared portal menu button.

findings.user_impact: Review routes need explicit preview/no-write action labels and no empty icon-only controls.
findings.expected_fix: Add shared preview banner and assert labeled menu/topbar controls.

requirements: Shared menu button uses aria-controls and aria-expanded.
Menu opens and closes with click, Escape, and backdrop/outside close where practical.
Focus remains inside the open menu panel and returns to the menu button when closed.
Preview banner is text-visible and not color-only.
All added controls have visible text or aria-label/title.
No route has text overlap or horizontal overflow at 390, 430, 768, 1024, and 1440 widths.
